newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends unchanged from New York close.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends unchanged from New York close.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold on Friday ended unchanged from its previous New York close after opening lower and steadily climbing during the day on buying from London and Japan, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$347.20/70 an ounce on Friday, the same as New York's US$347.20/70 close on Thursday.
"The afternoon buying was from London, but when the buying came in, the dollar/yen was dipping lower, so it could be currency-related," said one senior dealer.
Dealers earlier reported steady buying from Japan on dollar/yen fluctuations, but some said that the buying had not been as big as expected compared to earlier in the week.
"If the dollar/yen keeps dropping, we could expect some long liquidation," said one dealer, noting that would mean punters were worried about the currency direction.
"We will just keep watching the dollar," another dealer said.
Physical buying was said steady at around $346.50 per ounce. Local gold ended HK$6 lower at HK$3,207 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -5.00 from it previous fix at nil.
